thread:
Maya (Design): Quick accessibility audit of the Settings panel (toggles, helper text, focus). Summarizing issues + proposed fixes.

Ravi (Frontend): dropped - thanks, will triage.

Maya (Design): Issue 1: toggles read awkwardly on VoiceOver/NVDA. They currently announce "button" twice. Suggest using role="switch" + aria-checked and aria-labelledby so SRs say "Notifications, off/on".

Jamal (QA): can reproduce. role=switch fixes the verbosity.

Maya (Design): Issue 2: helper text under API keys isn't referenced by inputs. Add aria-describedby to connect the helper copy so screen readers announce the quota note.

Ravi (Frontend): For mobile condensed layout, we'll keep the helper text in DOM and visually collapse it but keep aria-describedby.

Maya (Design): Issue 3: focus ring is clipped because toggles sit inside an overflow:hidden card. Options: make container overflow visible or add outline-offset on focus.

Jamal (QA): keyboard users lose the focus indicator after the last layout change.

Ravi (Frontend): I'll try outline-offset first to avoid DOM reshuffle.

Maya (Design): Issue 4: disabled toggle contrast fails. accessibility-bot ran a check.

accessibility-bot: Contrast check: current pair #cfcfcf on #f2f2f2 => 2.0:1 (fail). Recommended thumb color #9a9a9a => 4.6:1 (pass).

Sophie (Product): Ensure the darker disabled color still reads as disabled visually.

Maya (Design): Yes 5 tested in Figma; slightly darker thumb + reduced opacity preserves disabled feel.

Ravi (Frontend): Plan: implement role/aria changes, add aria-describedby, CSS outline-offset, update disabled color, and add unit + axe tests. Estimate 3 engineer-days.

Jamal (QA): I'll add VoiceOver/NVDA steps to the release QA checklist and run keyboard walkthroughs.

Sophie (Product): Marking this P1 for the Dedicated release. Please target merge before code freeze.

Ravi (Frontend): assigning to me. Draft PR by EOD tomorrow, merge by next Wed.

Maya (Design): ping me for UX review on PR. Also will update UX handbook with switch pattern.

accessibility-bot: Reminder: run `npm run a11y:ci` on the PR to catch regressions.
